newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView upgrades Lucent.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView upgrades Lucent.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group analyst Chandan Sarkar said he upgraded his long-term rating on Lucent Technologies Inc to a buy from a hold.
-- Sarkar's short-term rating remains unchanged at a hold.
-- Sarkar also raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimates to $2.31 from $2.20 a share. His fiscal 1998 earnings estimates remain unchanged at $2.74.

-- Earlier Wednesday, Lucent reported third quarter earnings that blew past Wall Street expectations. Lucent reported $0.33 a share, versus First Call consensus estimate of $0.25 a share. Lucent's shares closed up six to 88-3/4.
